answers.core: It affects an existing core feature, and possibly allows to remove dependencies from it.
answers.workaround: Workarounds I've used so far require more than a few lines of code to expose an option in the editor to create a proxy mesh, which is an extra step for users each time they need to update a scene-wide navmesh.

title: Expose an API for the Navigation mesh generator to register custom geometry providers and reduce its dependencies
